# cpanel_email_domain_forwarder (Data Source)

Looks up the domain-level email forwarder for one cPanel mail domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_email_domain_forwarder" "legacy" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The source mail domain owned by the cPanel account.

### Read-Only

- `destination` (String) The external domain that receives mail sent to the source domain.
